acceptanceCriteria: Delivered spec-first: numbered requirements in the TOL-V0 spec, with focused tests tracing each.

Tests cover seed with aliases, duplicate-alias refusal, alias/native-id collision refusal, preflight match by alias in a title and a test.step title, no match inside a longer token, and crediting keyed to the native id.
body:
Source: GitHub beamfall/corvint#792.

## Problem
The obligation ledger (TOL-V0-003) only accepts `<PREFIX>-<n>` ids, so adopters with existing id schemes (`AREA-12-V03`, `M001`, `ABC-12.V4`, `V7`) cannot use the ledger, native preflight (TOL-V0-025..027), run-batch/qualify or expected-fail crediting without renumbering.

## Chosen design (issue option 2)
Keep the native numeric `id` and the wire shape. Add an optional `alias` per obligation (1..64 bytes, `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]*`). Refuse duplicate aliases and aliases colliding with a native id, with named refusal codes. Preflight and witness/qualify/expected-fail crediting accept the native id or the alias as a whole token; everything recorded stays keyed to the native id. Native id grammar unchanged.
